अभिकथन (A): शैक्षिक प्रबंधन में समस्या-समाधान और निर्णय-निर्माण समानार्थी और परस्पर विनिमेय शब्द हैं।

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Problem-solving and decision-making are synonymous and interchangeable concepts in administrative management.
Reason (R): While resolving any operational problem invariably necessitates making decisions, not all managerial decisions are elicited by an existing problem.
In light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english:
The correct answer is (d).
Assertion (A) is false: Problem-solving and decision-making are related but distinctly non-synonymous concepts. Problem-solving is a reactive or diagnostic process aimed at identifying discrepancies between actual and desired performance and eliminating specific obstacles. In contrast, decision-making is a broader cognitive and executive activity involving choosing between two or more alternatives; it encompasses opportunities, routine planning, proactive innovation, and strategic choices where no problem necessarily exists.
Reason (R) is true: Resolving a diagnosed problem always requires selecting a course of action (making a decision). However, many managerial decisions—such as adopting a celebratory program, planning an annual calendar, or approving standard leave—do not arise from a problem.
Hence, Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (d) है।
अभिकथन (A) गलत है: समस्या-समाधान और निर्णय-निर्माण समानार्थी नहीं हैं। समस्या-समाधान एक ऐसी प्रक्रिया है जो किसी विशिष्ट व्यवधान, कमी या कठिनाई को दूर करने के लिए शुरू की जाती है। दूसरी ओर, निर्णय-निर्माण एक व्यापक अवधारणा है जिसमें उपलब्ध विकल्पों में से किसी एक का चयन करना शामिल है; यह नए अवसरों के दोहन, सकारात्मक योजनाओं या नियमित कार्यों के लिए भी किया जाता है, जहाँ कोई समस्या उपस्थित नहीं होती।
कारण (R) सही है: जब भी किसी समस्या का निवारण करना होता है तो किसी न किसी विकल्प का चुनाव (निर्णय) करना ही पड़ता है। किंतु कई नियमित या विकासात्मक निर्णय (जैसे वार्षिक खेल उत्सव की तिथि तय करना) बिना किसी समस्या के भी लिए जाते हैं।
अतः A गलत है, परंतु R सही है।
questions.topic: Role of a Manager in an Organization
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A is false but R is true

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Problem-solving and decision-making are related but distinct concepts in educational management. Problem-solving involves diagnosing a specific difficulty and seeking corrective solutions. Decision-making is broader, involving choices between alternatives across routine, strategic, or positive opportunities. While resolving an operational problem requires making decisions, many administrative decisions, such as approving routine budgets or setting calendar schedules, do not involve solving existing problems.

questions.question_english: Which of the following is NOT a primary objective of staff development programs (In-service training) organized in schools?
options_english: Continuous upgrading of pedagogical strategies and instructional methods to align with revised curricula
Establishing administrative grounds for the immediate demotion or penalty of struggling teaching personnel
Systematic orientation of institutional faculty toward emerging state educational guidelines and policies
Fostering long-term professional growth, reflective teaching practices, and a healthy institutional climate
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). In-service staff development programs aim to enhance pedagogical competencies, update instructional methods, align practice with revised educational policies, and promote continuous professional growth. Their purpose is supportive and developmental rather than punitive. Using training sessions as administrative grounds to demote or penalize struggling teachers contradicts the professional development mission of staff training.

questions.question_english: Which form of organizational communication takes place when a Head of Department (HOD) coordinates directly with an HOD of a different academic discipline to implement a joint interdisciplinary project?
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). Horizontal (or lateral) communication occurs across peer colleagues, functional units, or department heads operating at the same hierarchical tier within an organizational structure. In an educational institution, direct communication between two Heads of Departments to coordinate cross-curricular curriculum design or interdisciplinary projects utilizes lateral channels. This facilitates interdepartmental cooperation, speeds up decision-making, and eliminates unnecessary administrative gatekeeping. Upward communication (Option a) flows from subordinates to superiors; Downward communication (Option c) flows from administrative leadership to subordinates; and Diagonal communication (Option d) crosses both functional boundaries and different hierarchical ranks simultaneously.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। क्षैतिज या पार्श्वीय संचार (Horizontal/Lateral communication) किसी संगठन में समान प्रशासनिक या पदानुक्रमिक स्तर पर कार्यरत समकक्ष अधिकारियों, संकायों या विभागाध्यक्षों के मध्य होता है। जब दो विभिन्न विभागों के विभागाध्यक्ष किसी अंतःविषयक परियोजना के संचालन के लिए परस्पर संवाद और समन्वय करते हैं, तो यह क्षैतिज संचार कहलाता है। यह विभागों के मध्य सूचनाओं के आदान-प्रदान और त्वरित निर्णय लेने में सहायक होता है। ऊर्ध्वगामी संचार (विकल्प a) अधीनस्थों से उच्च अधिकारियों की ओर जाता है; अधोगामी संचार (विकल्प c) उच्च अधिकारियों से अधीनस्थों की ओर आदेशों के रूप में प्रवाहित होता है; तथा तिर्यक संचार (विकल्प d) विभिन्न विभागों के अलग-अलग पदानुक्रमिक स्तरों के मध्य होता है।
questions.topic: Role of a Manager in an Organization

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding 'Democratic Supervision' in educational institutions:
I. It conceptualizes the teacher as an esteemed professional colleague rather than a subordinate.
II. It emphasizes mutual trust, respect, and shared organizational responsibility.
III. It relies primarily on surprise inspections and aggressive fault-finding to enforce compliance.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). Democratic supervision represents a progressive shift from punitive inspection toward supportive, cooperative educational leadership. Under democratic supervision, educators are treated as autonomous professional peers whose pedagogical insights are respected (Statement I is correct), and the supervisory climate is rooted in collegial trust, open communication, and collective responsibility for student learning (Statement II is correct). Statement III is incorrect because aggressive fault-finding, policing, and surprise inspections are hallmarks of authoritarian, inspectional models that stifle teacher initiative and generate institutional resentment. Therefore, only Statements I and II are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। लोकतांत्रिक पर्यवेक्षण दंडात्मक और सत्तावादी निरीक्षण के स्थान पर रचनात्मक मार्गदर्शन और सहयोग पर आधारित होता है। यह शिक्षक को केवल एक आज्ञाकारी अधीनस्थ न मानकर एक सम्मानित सहयोगी पेशेवर मानता है (कथन I सही है)। यह प्रधानाचार्य और शिक्षकों के मध्य आपसी विश्वास, सम्मान, रचनात्मक विमर्श और साझा उत्तरदायित्व को बढ़ावा देता है (कथन II सही है)। कथन III गलत है क्योंकि औचक छापे मारना, भय का माहौल बनाना और केवल दोष निकालना पारंपरिक निरंकुश निरीक्षण की पहचान है, जिसे लोकतांत्रिक पर्यवेक्षण में पूरी तरह खारिज किया गया है। अतः केवल कथन I और II सही हैं।
questions.topic: Role of a Manager in an Organization
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I and II only

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Democratic supervision views educators as professional colleagues rather than mere subordinates, fostering mutual respect, shared decision-making, and constructive feedback. It emphasizes guidance and professional support. Relying on fault-finding or surprise inspections to enforce discipline reflects traditional autocratic inspection rather than the supportive principles of democratic supervision.

questions.question_english: When conducting a SWOT analysis for an educational institution, a Principal examining the “Weaknesses” dimension will primarily focus on which of the following?
options_english: Adverse external macro-environmental conditions and external threats that could undermine institutional stability
Favorable external funding opportunities, governmental grants, and prospective educational philanthropy programs
Internal organizational limitations, resource deficits, and operational constraints that disadvantage the school
Institutional capabilities, competitive advantages, and market strengths demonstrated by neighboring competitor schools
questions.explanation_english:
In strategic planning and organizational management, a SWOT analysis categorizes institutional factors along two dimensions: internal vs. external, and helpful vs. harmful. 'Strengths' and 'Weaknesses' represent internal organizational attributes over which the institution exercises direct control. Specifically, 'Weaknesses' are internal limitations, resource deficits, infrastructural shortages, pedagogical gaps, or operational bottlenecks that hinder the school from achieving its mission and optimal educational outcomes.
- Option A is incorrect because adverse macro-environmental conditions and external risks represent 'Threats' (T), which originate from outside the organization.
- Option B is incorrect because prospective external grants and philanthropic funding represent 'Opportunities' (O), which are favorable external environmental conditions.
- Option D is incorrect because evaluating the distinctive capabilities and market strengths of competing neighboring schools is part of external competitive benchmarking rather than an internal weakness assessment.
questions.explanation_hindi:
रणनीतिक प्रबंधन में स्वाट (SWOT) विश्लेषण किसी संगठन की आंतरिक और बाह्य परिस्थितियों का मूल्यांकन करने का एक महत्वपूर्ण ढांचा है। इसमें 'शक्तियां' (Strengths) और 'कमजोरियां' (Weaknesses) आंतरिक कारकों को दर्शाती हैं, जिन पर संस्थान का प्रत्यक्ष नियंत्रण होता है। 'कमजोरियां' विद्यालय की आंतरिक सीमाओं, शिक्षण संसाधनों के अभाव, अपर्याप्त बुनियादी ढांचे, संकाय की कमी अथवा परिचालनगत कमियों को इंगित करती हैं जो शैक्षणिक गुणवत्ता और संस्थागत प्रदर्शन में बाधा बनती हैं।
- विकल्प (A) गलत है क्योंकि प्रतिकूल बाह्य पर्यावरणीय परिस्थितियाँ 'खतरों' (Threats) का हिस्सा हैं, जो संस्थान के बाहर से उत्पन्न होते हैं।
- विकल्प (B) गलत है क्योंकि बाह्य अनुदान और परोपकारी अवसर 'अवसरों' (Opportunities) का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं, जो बाह्य परिवेश से प्राप्त होते हैं।
- विकल्प (D) गलत है क्योंकि पड़ोसी विद्यालयों की प्रतिस्पर्धी क्षमताओं का विश्लेषण बाह्य प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक मूल्यांकन का हिस्सा है, न कि आंतरिक कमजोरी का।
questions.topic: Role of a Manager in an Organization
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Internal organizational limitations, resource deficits, and operational constraints that disadvantage the school

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In a SWOT analysis, Weaknesses represent internal limitations, resource deficits, or operational inefficiencies that hinder institutional performance. Analyzing weaknesses enables school administrators to identify internal gaps, such as outdated facilities or staffing shortages, and implement targeted strategies to strengthen operations and improve educational outcomes.

questions.question_english: In administrative decision-making theory, Herbert Simon’s concept of 'Bounded Rationality' posits that:
options_english: Administrators systematically evaluate every conceivable alternative to achieve absolute optimization and maximum organizational utility.
Decision-makers operate within cognitive limits, incomplete information, and finite time, leading to satisficing rather than optimizing choices.
Administrative decisions are strictly circumscribed by statutory legislation, departmental codes, and legal mandates.
Managerial choices are permanently bounded by fiscal deficits and rigid institutional budget ceilings.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). The concept of 'Bounded Rationality', developed by Nobel laureate Herbert A. Simon, argues that purely rational, optimizing decision-making is impossible in real-world organizations. Human decision-makers face three fundamental constraints: (1) imperfect and incomplete information, (2) cognitive limitations in processing complex information, and (3) limited time to decide. Consequently, rather than searching exhaustively for an ideal 'maximizing' solution, administrators practice 'satisficing'—selecting an alternative that is good enough and meets acceptable thresholds. Option (a) describes classical economic rationality (maximizing model), which Simon rejected. Options (c) and (d) refer to legal or fiscal boundaries, but 'bounded rationality' specifically refers to cognitive and informational constraints.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। नोबेल पुरस्कार विजेता हर्बर्ट साइमन द्वारा प्रतिपादित 'सीमित तार्किकता' का सिद्धांत यह स्पष्ट करता है कि वास्तविक प्रशासनिक स्थितियों में पूर्ण तार्किकता (आदर्श निर्णय) संभव नहीं है। निर्णयकर्ता तीन प्रमुख सीमाओं से घिरे होते हैं: अपूर्ण या सीमित जानकारी, मानव मस्तिष्क की सीमित संज्ञानात्मक प्रसंस्करण क्षमता और निर्णय लेने के लिए उपलब्ध सीमित समय। इसलिए, प्रशासक सभी विकल्पों को तलाशने के बजाय संतोषप्रद विकल्प चुनते हैं जो उस समय की परिस्थितियों में पर्याप्त और संतोषजनक हो। विकल्प (a) शास्त्रीय आर्थिक तार्किकता को दर्शाता है। विकल्प (c) और (d) केवल कानूनी या वित्तीय सीमाओं को इंगित करते हैं, जो इस संज्ञानात्मक सिद्धांत का मूल भाव नहीं हैं।

questions.question_english: An instructional supervisor observes a classroom session not to detect faults, but to collaboratively analyze the teaching-learning process based on pre-observation agreements. Following the lesson, they meet in a supportive setting to examine observational data. This methodology is an example of:
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Clinical supervision, originally conceptualized by Morris Cogan and Robert Goldhammer, is a formative, collaborative cycle designed to improve instructional performance through direct classroom observation and supportive feedback. In Luther Gulick and Lyndall Urwick’s classic administrative framework POSDCORB (Planning, Organizing, Staffing, Directing, Coordinating, Reporting, Budgeting), 'Organizing' is defined as the establishment of the formal structure of authority through which work subdivisions are arranged, defined, and coordinated for the attainment of organizational objectives. Creating departmental divisions, assigning specific tasks to those departments, and establishing spans of control (the number of direct subordinates an administrator oversees) are central dimensions of the organizing function.
- Option B is incorrect because Planning involves formulating goals and outlining strategic roadmaps.
- Option C is incorrect because Staffing pertains to recruitment, selection, professional training, and managing conditions of service.

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). questions.question_english:
Consider the following pairs of organizational theorists and their seminal contributions to management and leadership theory:
I. Fred Fiedler — Contingency Model of Leadership
II. Abraham Maslow — Two-Factor Hygiene Theory
III. Paul Hersey and Ken Blanchard — Situational Leadership Model
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
questions.explanation_english:
The correct answer is (b). Pairs I and III are correctly matched, whereas Pair II is incorrectly matched.
- Pair I is correctly matched: Fred Fiedler formulated the Contingency Model of Leadership, asserting that group performance depends on the interaction between a leader's style (assessed via the Least Preferred Co-worker / LPC scale) and the degree of situational favorableness (leader-member relations, task structure, and position power).
- Pair II is incorrectly matched: The Two-Factor Theory (also known as the Motivator-Hygiene Theory) was developed by Frederick Herzberg in 1959, proposing that job satisfaction and job dissatisfaction are driven by distinct sets of factors (motivators vs. hygiene factors). Abraham Maslow proposed the Hierarchy of Needs Theory (physiological, safety, love/belonging, esteem, and self-actualization).
- Pair III is correctly matched: Paul Hersey and Kenneth Blanchard developed the Situational Leadership Theory (SLT), which posits that the most effective leadership style (Directing, Coaching, Supporting, or Delegating) depends on the developmental maturity or readiness level of the followers.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (b) है। युग्म I और III सही सुमेलित हैं, जबकि युग्म II गलत सुमेलित है।
- युग्म I सही है: फ्रेड फिडलर ने नेतृत्व का 'आकस्मिकता मॉडल' प्रतिपादित किया था, जिसके अनुसार नेतृत्व की प्रभावशीलता नेता की शैली और स्थिति की अनुकूलता (नेता-सदस्य संबंध, कार्य संरचना, और पद शक्ति) के सामंजस्य पर निर्भर करती है।
- युग्म II गलत है: 'द्वि-कारक सिद्धांत' (आरोग्य एवं प्रेरक कारक) का प्रतिपादन फ्रेडरिक हर्जबर्ग द्वारा 1959 में किया गया था। अब्राहम मैस्लो ने 'आवश्यकता पदानुक्रम सिद्धांत' (मानव आवश्यकताओं का पांच-स्तरीय पदानुक्रम) का प्रतिपादन किया था।
- युग्म III सही है: पॉल हर्सी और केन ब्लैंचर्ड ने 'परिस्थितिजन्य नेतृत्व मॉडल' विकसित किया था, जिसके अनुसार नेता की उपयुक्त कार्य-शैली अनुयायियों की परिपक्वता या तत्परता के स्तर (सक्षमता और प्रतिबद्धता) के अनुसार बदलनी चाहिए।
